title: Remote Biomedical Informatics SME - 58854
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world's leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L

Role Overview:

We are seeking highly skilled Biomedical Informatics Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to join our team in developing rigorous, high-quality evaluation questions designed to assess and challenge advanced AI models. The primary objective is to create benchmark questions that test the boundaries of AI capabilities across diverse bioinformatics domains.

This role requires deep technical expertise combined with the ability to craft precise, unambiguous questions with well-defined evaluations. The ideal candidate will possess not only strong theoretical knowledge but also practical experience in designing assessment materials that have deterministic, verifiable outcomes.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop challenging bioinformatics coding questions that push the limits of AI model capabilities.
  • Create automated, coding-based evaluations with unit tests that objectively verify correctness.
  • Build comprehensive evaluation rubrics with 7–10 distinct criteria for each bioinformatics question.
  • Ensure every question is self-contained, well-defined, and completely unambiguous, including all domain rules and edge cases.
  • Develop problems where there is exactly one correct answer or outcome that can be deterministically validated.
  • Translate theoretical bioinformatics concepts into concrete, measurable outputs.
  • Enforce performance requirements with explicit constraints and tests to prevent inefficient or brute-force solutions.

Required Qualifications:

Educational Background

  • Master's degree of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
  • Ongoing PhD with 3+ years of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
  • PhD (completed) in Biomedical Informatics, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology or a closely related field (preferred).

Technical and other skills

  • Strong proficiency in biomedical data processing, analysis, and interpretation, including working with large‐scale datasets.
  • Experience with bioinformatics tools and pipelines (e.g., NGS workflows, multi‐omics, etc.).
  • Solid programming skills in Python / R
  • Experience working in Linux/Unix, Docker and version control.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills for working in interdisciplinary research teams

Domain Expertise Requirements

Candidates must demonstrate deep, expert-level knowledge in at least TWO (2) of the following five core bioinformatics domains:

1. Biomedical Image Processing

  • Processing of Radiology imaging: CT, MRI, PET/SPECT, Ultrasound imaging
  • Automating cell counting, identifying cell types, and analyzing tissue structures in pathology slides
  • Computational segmentation and boundary inference
  • Medical image formation, reconstruction & enhancement
  • Noise modeling and statistical denoising
  • Image sampling theory and resolution limits
  • Intensity standardization and harmonization
  • Geometric transformations and spatial calibration
  • Multi-modal image registration and alignment
  • Morphological and topological shape analysis
  • Quantitative imaging feature extraction
  • Fusing data from different modalities (MRI, PET, Genomics) for a comprehensive view to tailor treatments
  • pattern recognition and predictive modeling

2. Biomedical Signal Processing

  • Cardiovascular/hemodynamic signals (ECG, PPG, BP, HRV, etc)
  • Neural/brain electrical signals (EEG, EP/ERP; seizure/cognitive analysis)
  • Neuromuscular/motor signals (EMG, motor unit decomposition; prosthetics/rehab)
  • Ocular/visual system signals (EOG, blink/saccade analysis)
  • Respiratory signals (airflow, effort; sleep/disordered breathing)
  • Nonlinear, Statistical, and Adaptive Signal Analysis
  • Multichannel, Spatial, and Connectivity Signal Analysis
  • Machine Learning and Data‐Driven Biomedical Signal Analysis
  • Clinical Monitoring, Wearable, and Translational Signal Processing

3. Molecular & Omics based Personalized Medicine

  • Omics based risk / disease prediction (GWAS, PRS, bulk, single‐cell RNA‐seq, proteins / metabolite signatures associated with diseases)
  • Risk Prediction and Prognosis Modeling
  • Molecular patient subtyping
  • Liquid Biopsy and Circulating Biomarkers (ctDNA, cfRNA/miRNA, MRD, etc.)
  • Causal Inference & Mechanistic Inference (ATE/CATE, Trial emulation and counterfactual modeling)
  • Cross‐modal data fusion (omics + EHR + imaging / signals)
  • Longitudinal Patient Modeling and Disease Progression
  • Patient Stratification and Subtyping (molecular subtypes, endotypes)
  • Electronic Health Records and Clinical Data Science

4. Drug Discovery & Repurposing

  • Treatment response prediction
  • Structure-based drug design (Molecular docking, binding site analysis, Virtual screening workflow)
  • Protein structure analysis (PDB/mmCIF handling)
  • Chemoinformatics ( Ligand-based screening, molecular fingerprinting, 2D/3D data handling and chemical space analysis)
  • QSAR & ADMET Modeling
  • Drug–target interaction prediction
  • Drug sensitivity prediction in disease models
  • Repurposing via omics/network associations
  • Predictive Modeling for Drug Discovery Molecular Dynamics Simulation of Biomolecules (QM, DFT, stability, reactivity, PCA analysis )

5. Software / Utilities

  • Tool installation & environment management (docker/conda/pip)
  • Format conversion/validation (FASTA/FASTQ, BAM/VCF, PDB)
  • GUI-driven analysis workflows (step-by-step runs)
  • Workflow automation (scripts wrapping GUI tools)
  • Visualization tools (genome browsers, 3D viewers)
  • Container/VM execution and troubleshooting
  • Batch processing and report generation
  • Pipeline interoperability checks
  • Reproducibility packaging (configs, manifests)
  • Debugging typical bioinformatics tool errors

6. Regulatory Science and Clinical Policies

  • FDA/EMA regulatory pathways
  • Clinical Practice Guidelines & Standards of Care (e.g., NCCN, AHA, etc.)
  • Diagnostic Biomarker & Therapeutic Use Constraints
  • Medical Scenario Reasoning (case vignettes, Differential diagnosis)
  • Data & Content Compliance
  • Ethical Use, Safety, and Harm Prevention
  • Model Use Governance & Auditability
  • Policy‐Aligned Language & Communication
  • Clinical validation and cohort generalization
  • Privacy‐preserving learning

Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.

Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : At least 30 hours per week. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 2 months; (expected start date is next week)

Evaluation Process:

  • Take home Assessment on Biomedical Informatics (2-6 hours)
  • Delivery discussion(15-30mins)

After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Gerente Executivo de Inteligência Operacional
description:
Na RD Saúde, você vai acelerar seu aprendizado em um ambiente dinâmico, com oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento e crescimento profissional.

Somos líderes no mercado brasileiro de farmácias, com lojas em todo o país e mais de 60 mil pessoas apaixonadas por cuidar de gente. Trilhamos um caminho de desenvolvimento que impulsiona carreiras e transforma futuros. Juntos por uma sociedade de mais saudável impactamos mais de 1 milhão de vidas e queremos ir ainda mais longe — de forma sólida, humana e lado a lado com você. Venha fazer parte dessa jornada e trilhar um caminho que transforma.

Principais Responsabilidades:

1. Mapeamento, Padronização e Melhoria Contínua de Processos

• Mapear, analisar, redesenhar e otimizar processos ponta a ponta, garantindo eficiência operacional, conformidade regulatória, escalabilidade e foco no cliente interno.

• Atuar de forma transversal junto às lideranças das áreas, promovendo visão integrada dos fluxos, redução de retrabalhos, mitigação de riscos operacionais e financeiros e diminuição de tempos de ciclo.

• Abranger processos das seguintes áreas: Contas a Pagar, Contas a Receber, Fiscal e Tributário, Custos, Contabilidade, Legalização de Lojas, Folha de Pagamento e Benefícios

• Atendimento de chamados provenientes das Lojas e Centros de Distribuição (CSC), incluindo demandas de folha, benefícios, manutenção de lojas e rotinas administrativas e operacionais.

• Implementar metodologias de melhoria contínua e excelência operacional, garantindo padronização e sustentabilidade dos ganhos.

2. Liderança das Frentes de Automação, Inteligência Artificial e Dados

• Liderar a célula de Automação, Inteligência Artificial e Dados, atualmente com aproximadamente 400 robôs em produção, assegurando: governança do pipeline de automações, estabilidade e resiliência operacional, e evolução tecnológica contínua e mensuração estruturada de ganhos de produtividade e retorno sobre investimento (ROI).

• Definir, priorizar e executar o roadmap estratégico de automação e uso de IA aplicada a processos administrativos, financeiros e operacionais.

• Coordenar a estratégia de dados da diretoria, incluindo:

• Desenvolvimento e evolução de BI's executivos e operacionais

• Gestão de data lake e fontes de dados

• Definição e monitoramento de indicadores de desempenho, produtividade, SLA, qualidade e eficiência

3. Políticas, Normas e Governança de Processos

• Estruturar, revisar e manter políticas, normas e procedimentos da diretoria, assegurando: conformidade legal, regulatória e fiscal, padronização operacional em larga escala e clareza de papéis, responsabilidades e níveis de decisão.

• Atuar como guardião dos processos críticos, garantindo sua correta aplicação, atualização contínua e aderência às melhores práticas de mercado.

4. Governança, Metas e Gestão Executiva

• Estruturar e liderar o modelo de governança da diretoria, incluindo: definição e gestão de metas, KPIs e OKRs, rituais de acompanhamento, fóruns executivos e comitês de decisão e monitoramento de performance e direcionamento estratégico.

• Gerir o orçamento da área, incluindo investimentos em tecnologia, automação, dados e projetos de melhoria contínua.

• Elaborar e apresentar materiais executivos para diretoria e comitês, com visão analítica, estratégica e orientada a dados.

5. Gestão de Projetos e Evolução de Sistemas

• Liderar projetos estratégicos de implementação, evolução e otimização de sistemas que suportam o CSC e Suprimentos Indiretos, incluindo: ERPs, sistemas fiscais, financeiros e de folha de pagamento, plataformas de chamados, automação e analytics.

• Atuar como interface entre áreas de negócio, tecnologia e fornecedores, assegurando entregas dentro de prazo, custo, escopo e qualidade esperados.

• Garantir alinhamento entre soluções tecnológicas e objetivos estratégicos do negócio.

Requisitos:

  • Superior completo.
  • Experiência executiva sólida em: Centros de Serviços Compartilhados, processos financeiros, administrativos, contábeis e fiscais, transformação operacional em ambientes complexos e de grande escala.
  • Liderança de iniciativas de automação, dados e analytics.
  • Vivência em organizações com alto nível de governança, controles e exigências regulatórias.
  • Desejável formação complementar ou certificações em: Gestão de Processos (BPM, Lean, Six Sigma), Gestão de Projetos (PMI, PMP, Agile, Scrum).
  • Automação de Processos (RPA).
  • Data Analytics, BI e Inteligência Artificial aplicada a negócios.
  • Governança, Riscos e Compliance.

description:

Instituição de grande porte, com trajetória sólida e reconhecida no setor de serviços, tem como propósito central o cuidado com as pessoas e a promoção da saúde com responsabilidade e excelência. A organização investe de forma contínua em tecnologia, estrutura e no desenvolvimento dos seus profissionais. Inserida em um contexto de crescimento sustentável, proporciona estabilidade, relações profissionais sólidas e a oportunidade de fazer parte de um trabalho que gera impacto positivo e duradouro na vida das pessoas.

Atividades:

  • Este profissional terá um papel estratégico na promoção da segurança do paciente e da qualidade assistencial. Atuará de forma integrada com as equipes assistenciais e com a liderança da instituição, contribuindo para o fortalecimento das boas práticas e para a excelência dos cuidados prestados.
  • Entre suas atribuições, destaca-se a atuação estratégica na prevenção e no controle de infecções, com impacto direto na segurança do paciente e na qualidade assistencial. Será responsável pela vigilância epidemiológica contínua, realizando o monitoramento de indicadores, a análise de tendências e a identificação de riscos, sempre com foco em ações preventivas e na melhoria dos processos assistenciais.
  • Também caberá a este profissional desenvolver, revisar e implementar protocolos e rotinas assistenciais, assegurando a aderência às diretrizes institucionais e às melhores práticas do setor. A liderança da educação continuada das equipes de saúde será parte fundamental do papel, por meio da condução de treinamentos, orientações técnicas e atualizações periódicas, promovendo uma cultura sólida de segurança.
  • Como referência técnica, o(a) Coordenador(a) Médico(a) apoiará estratégias que garantam tratamentos eficazes, seguros e sustentáveis, alinhados às boas práticas assistenciais. Participará ativamente de comissões e grupos institucionais, contribuindo para a definição de políticas, diretrizes e decisões relacionadas ao controle de infecção e à segurança assistencial.
  • Adicionalmente, representará a área junto à direção da instituição, apresentando análises, resultados e propostas de melhoria. Será responsável por coordenar reuniões técnicas, definir pautas, conduzir discussões e acompanhar a execução das ações acordadas, bem como elaborar e acompanhar relatórios técnicos e indicadores epidemiológicos, garantindo rastreabilidade, conformidade regulatória e suporte qualificado à tomada de decisão.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Medicina;
  • Especialização ou Residência em Infectologia;
  • Experiência comprovada na atuação como Médico(a) Infectologista, preferencialmente em ambiente hospitalar;
  • Capacidade de implementar, monitorar e avaliar medidas de prevenção e controle de infecções;
  • Vivência na elaboração e acompanhamento de protocolos, indicadores e relatórios técnicos relacionados ao controle de infecção.

title: Country Manager(South America)
description:
Job description(focus on Utility BESS):

  • Develop and execute sales strategies based on the market demand of the country and region, formulate and implement sales strategies, promote the market development and project implementation of utility-scale BESS products, and achieve the sales targets and payment collection set by the company.
  • Manage and expand customer relationships by identifying, following up with, and closing potential clients, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction.
  • Provide technical and business solution support by having an in-depth understanding of utility-scale BESS business solutions, working closely with the technical team to offer customized solutions for clients.
  • Research and understand grid policies and regulations in research on national and regional power grid policies, regulations and market trends, to ensure that products and solutions comply with local laws and standards.
  • Conduct market analysis and reporting on market trends, competitors, and customer needs, providing regular sales progress and market analysis reports to the company.
  • Team collaboration and training: Assist in building the team in the international market and provide relevant training and support to team members.

Job requirements:

  • Educational background: Bachelor's degree or higher, major is not limited, power systems, energy management, or a related field.
  • Work experience: More than 5 years of working experience in new energy storage or photovoltaic and wind power development, working experience in Chinese enterprises is preferred, and able to adapt to international business trips.
  • Policy knowledge: Familiar with the national and regional power grid policies, energy regulations and market trends, able to adjust sales strategies according to policy changes.
  • Technical background: Possesses a background in power systems and energy storage technologies, with the ability to understand and explain both technical and business solutions to clients.
  • Communication and negotiation skills: Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to work effectively with clients and team members.
  • Language skills: Fluent in English, capable of conducting technical and business negotiations. Proficiency in Chinese is a plus.

title: Driver Livestreamer (GoPro)
description:
City Explorer

City Explorer is a global livestreaming platform showing real cities in real time. We are looking for drivers and riders to livestream daily street-level views of their city using GoPro cameras.

This is a paid contributor role, designed as an additional income opportunity.

What you will do:

  • Livestream city streets from your point of view while driving or riding
  • Stream using a GoPro mounted on a windshield, chest strap, or helmet, depending on your vehicle
  • Offer viewers around the world a unique street-level cityscape perspective
  • Livestream an average of 4–5 hours per day

Who can apply:

  • Highly recommended for taxi drivers, ride-hailing drivers, delivery drivers, or similar roles who are already on the road daily
  • Also open to anyone willing to drive or ride around and livestream the streets
  • You can use any mode of transport: car, motorbike, bicycle, truck, or similar
  • You do not need to be a licensed taxi or delivery driver
  • You are comfortable moving around for extended periods
  • You follow local traffic laws and safety rules at all times

Compensation & support:

  • $150 per month base contribution
  • Donations from viewers
  • Monthly performance bonus
  • Internet costs covered
  • GoPro camera and installation provided free of charge

Why join:

  • Earn extra income while doing your daily driving or riding
  • No talking or content creation required
  • Be part of a global platform showcasing cities from the streets

title: Remote Business Analyst - 57510
description:
bout Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world's leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems.

Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L

About the Role:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Business Analyst to support evaluation and annotation workflows focused on quality, accuracy, and structured reasoning. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working with digital tools, performing side-by-side evaluations, and providing clear, well-supported justifications based on fact-checking.

Responsibilities:

  • Perform side-by-side (SxS) evaluations on GHD, comparing outputs and assessing quality, accuracy, and relevance.
  • Conduct fact-checking to validate information and identify inconsistencies or inaccuracies.
  • Provide detailed, well-structured justifications to support evaluation decisions.
  • Follow established evaluation guidelines and quality standards consistently.
  • Use browser-based tools and extensions to support analysis and review tasks.
  • Execute simple command-line instructions when required to support evaluation workflows.
  • Document findings clearly and communicate insights to stakeholders when needed.

Requirements:

  • Solid comfort using a computer in a professional setting.
  • Experience working with browser extensions and online tools.
  • Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required).
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • High attention to detail and ability to justify decisions clearly and objectively.
  • Comfortable working with evaluation frameworks, comparisons, and structured analysis.
  • Good written communication skills in English.

Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience with evaluation, annotation, QA, or audit-type work.
  • Familiarity with data quality, content evaluation, or model/output assessments.
  • Background in business analysis, operations, or process improvement.

Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful research initiatives.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.

Offer Details:

  • Commitment Required: 30 hours per week minimum.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor/Freelancer (no medical or paid leave).
  • Time Overlap: Some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2–5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles.

Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete an analytical challenge.
  • Once the assessment is cleared, you're ready to start contributing!

After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: "Gerente de Projetos SAP Sênior #992612"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A Dexian incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Gerenciar o processo de pré-projeto, elaborando pré-orçamentos, RFPs, Equalizações de Propostas, Parecer técnico/gerencial;
  • Monitorar e formalizar evolução do processo de pré-projeto;
  • Apoiar na definição e planejamento de escopo, metas e entregáveis;
  • Definir e aplicar a melhor metodologia de gestão, tais como guia PMBOK, framework Scrum, e outras ferramentas de gestão de projetos;
  • Discutir, compreender e zelar, gerencialmente, sobre os entregáveis do projeto, visando garantir qualidade;
  • Engajar, gerir e desenvolver equipe multidisciplinar em cada projeto;
  • Desdobrar brieffing técnico e orientar equipes de negócio/ técnicas internas e fornecedores;
  • Garantir a consolidação do padrão de governança requerido pela área de projetos para o gerenciamento das demandas, visando atender auditorias futuras;
  • Criar controles, gerenciá-los e garantir: escopo, custo, qualidade, cronograma, riscos, comunicação e satisfação para as partes interessadas do projeto;
  • Elaborar de material e conduzir reuniões com informações sobre os milestones para diferentes tipos de público;
  • Gerir, direcionar e monitorar riscos / issues e suas mitigações / resoluções;
  • Propor e monitorar decisões envolvendo definições do projeto e solução de problemas;
  • Conduzir processos de pós-projeto - Garantir transferência de conhecimento de Projetos para a equipe de Sustentação;
  • Avaliar a priorização de projetos.

O que você precisa ter

  • Capacidade de adaptação imediata a novos processos de maneira ágil e autodidata;
  • Muito dinamismo na adaptação de projetos em andamento;
  • Gestão de terceiros , controle horas e aprovação;
  • Gestão financeira dos projetos – planejado x realizado x forecast;
  • Controle eficaz de documentação dos projetos (kick-off, status Report, cronograma, termos de aceite, etc..);
  • Alta capacidade de elaboração e apresentação de maneira confiante os Reports aos stakeholders
  • Conhecimento em projetos de implementação SAP.

Será um destaque seu perfil com

  • Atuação em projetos de incorporação societária (M&A);
  • Projetos Fiscais;
  • Ter atuado como Consultor Funcional SAP, é um grande diferencial.

Onde você vai trabalhar?

Celebramos a troca, relações e o poder do contato. Regime Híbrido em São Paulo/SP, atuando presencialmente 2x na semana.

title: HRBP Specialist (Senador Canedo / GO)
description:
Coty is one of the world's largest beauty companies, with an iconic portfolio of fragrance, color cosmetics, skin care and body care brands. At Coty, we celebrate and cultivate a culture of kindness. Therefore, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We believe that beauty lies in diversity, and we are committed to continuing to build an environment where all talents can shine, valuing the unique contributions each individual brings to our teams. As part of our commitment to inclusion, all profiles are welcome.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Act as the HR Business Partner for Supply Chain leadership (Manufacturing, Maintenance, Quality, Logistics and Industrial Support functions), ensuring alignment between HR strategy and the needs of the industrial business;
  • Support people management in a manufacturing environment, considering operational specifics such as shift work, schedules, hourly workforce, absenteeism and union relations;
  • Lead and support core HR cycles within Supply Chain structures, including performance management, Talent Review, Individual Development Plans (IDPs), succession planning and internal movements;
  • Actively contribute to initiatives related to organizational climate, employee engagement, performance and people development;
  • Support recruitment and selection processes for operational, technical and administrative roles, in close partnership with the Talent Acquisition team;
  • Ensure correct application of internal HR policies, talent management practices and compliance with labor legislation, as well as health and safety standards;
  • Serve as the HR focal point for organizational change processes, restructurings, conflict management and disciplinary matters;
  • Work closely with HR Centers of Excellence (Talent Acquisition & Management, Compensation, HR Services, Health & Safety) to ensure consistency and excellence in HR delivery for Supply Chain teams;
  • Monitor and analyze HR operational indicators (turnover, absenteeism, headcount, overtime, disciplinary cases, among others), proposing corrective and preventive actions.

REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Solid experience as an HR Business Partner or HR Generalist supporting Supply Chain and/or industrial/manufacturing environments;
  • Proven experience working with operational populations, shop floor leadership and HR routines closely connected to daily operations;
  • Fluency in English (advanced/fluency level for verbal and written communication with global and regional teams);
  • Strong knowledge of labor legislation and labor/union relations practices;
  • Hands-on profile, with strong field presence and close interaction with leaders and employees;
  • Strong analytical skills, organization, prioritization ability and problem-solving mindset;
  • Strong communication skills, relationship-building capability, active listening and influencing skills;
  • Bachelor's degree completed.

Document system designs, processes, and best practices to maintain operational clarity.

Proven experience with Microsoft Dynamics AX (AX 2012).

Hands-on development experience using C# and .NET.

Background as a DAX / Microsoft Engineer, with strong understanding of enterprise systems.

Comfortable in a techno-functional role, engaging both technical and business stakeholders.

Experience supporting on-premise enterprise systems and ensuring operational stability.

Preferred Experience:

Previous exposure to transportation, logistics, or supply chain industries.

Experience with large-scale, enterprise ERP environments.

Understanding of operational workflows in supply chain or freight operations.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Company Description


EMP is a media and technology company building audience-driven brands across digital media, content, and now SaaS products.

We started as a digital media group with a fan-first mindset and have grown into a company that blends content, distribution, and technology. Today, we are expanding beyond media into software products that support creators, brands, and audiences. That means design work here goes beyond social graphics and videos. It increasingly touches product thinking, UX/UI, and how software is presented to users.

We move fast, test often, and care about clean execution. Collaboration matters, but so does ownership. If you like building things that ship and actually get used, you will fit in well here.


You Are


An experienced graphic designer who can execute high-quality visual work across media and digital products. You are comfortable working in fast-moving environments, collaborating with editors, marketers, and product-minded teammates. You care about clarity, usability, and aesthetics, not just making things look cool.

You are also curious about software and product design, and you are interested in expanding your skill set into UX/UI and SaaS-oriented design work.


Role Description

This is a full-time, remote role for a Graphic Designer.

You will create visual assets across our media brands, including graphics, branding elements, and design systems for social, web, and video. You will also support our growing SaaS initiatives by contributing to UX/UI design, product mockups, and software framing using tools like Figma.

Your work will sit at the intersection of content, marketing, and product. You will help translate ideas into clean visuals, clear user flows, and consistent brand experiences across platforms.

Day-to-day responsibilities include concepting, designing, iterating based on feedback, and collaborating with media, marketing, and product stakeholders.


Responsibilities


  • Design graphics, branding assets, and visual systems for digital media platforms
  • Support video and social content with strong visual design
  • Contribute to UX/UI design for SaaS and internal software products
  • Create wireframes, mockups, and product flows using Figma

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Company Description


EMP is a media and technology company building audience-driven brands across digital media, content, and now SaaS products.

We started as a digital media group with a fan-first mindset and have grown into a company that blends content, distribution, and technology. Today, we are expanding beyond media into software products that support creators, brands, and audiences. That means design work here goes beyond social graphics and videos. It increasingly touches product thinking, UX/UI, and how software is presented to users.

We move fast, test often, and care about clean execution. Collaboration matters, but so does ownership. If you like building things that ship and actually get used, you will fit in well here.


You Are


An experienced graphic designer who can execute high-quality visual work across media and digital products. You are comfortable working in fast-moving environments, collaborating with editors, marketers, and product-minded teammates. You care about clarity, usability, and aesthetics, not just making things look cool.

You are also curious about software and product design, and you are interested in expanding your skill set into UX/UI and SaaS-oriented design work.


Role Description

This is a full-time, remote role for a Graphic Designer.

You will create visual assets across our media brands, including graphics, branding elements, and design systems for social, web, and video. You will also support our growing SaaS initiatives by contributing to UX/UI design, product mockups, and software framing using tools like Figma.

Your work will sit at the intersection of content, marketing, and product. You will help translate ideas into clean visuals, clear user flows, and consistent brand experiences across platforms.

Day-to-day responsibilities include concepting, designing, iterating based on feedback, and collaborating with media, marketing, and product stakeholders.


Responsibilities


  • Design graphics, branding assets, and visual systems for digital media platforms
  • Support video and social content with strong visual design

  • Create wireframes, mockups, and product flows using Figma
  • Maintain brand consistency across media, web, and product surfaces

  • Iterate quickly and incorporate feedback without friction


Qualifications

  • Attention to detail and strong design judgment
  • Clear communication skills and ability to work independently in a remote setup
  • Experience in digital media, marketing, or tech is a plus
  • Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or equivalent experience
  • Fluent in English, written and spoken

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Job Title: Senior Data Engineer (Snowflake & Observability Implementation)

Location: LATAM (Remote)

Duration: 6 Months

Need to work on PST hours


Mandatory Skills : Snowflake

DBT, Splunk, OpsGenie, Snowflake + Streamlit, Splunk Dashboards and Version Control & IaC


Role Overview

We are seeking a proactive and hands-on Senior Data Engineer to drive the execution phase of our migration from Amazon Redshift to Snowflake. The architectural design is complete; we need a builder who can code, implement, and operationalize the solution with a heavy focus on Good Governance, Data Quality, and Observability at scale.

You will pick up where a previous engagement left off, leveraging DBT for transformations and driving the roadmap for 2026. You will work alongside an existing Data Engineer but are expected to lead the implementation with high initiative.


Key Responsibilities

1. Migration & Transformation Execution

  • Lead the Implementation: Execute the transition from Redshift to Snowflake based on existing designs.
  • DBT Transformation: Utilize DBT to manage transformations for DMS (Database Migration Service) outputs and ensure seamless data integration.
  • Code & Drive: This is not a passive role. You will be responsible for writing the code, configuring the environment, and driving the project forward to meet 2026 roadmap goals.
  • Measure Output: Implement metrics to validate and measure the output of DMS processes to ensure accuracy.


2. Data Observability & Alerting at Scale

  • Enterprise Alerting Integration: Operationalize a Proof of Concept (POC) that connects Splunk to OpsGenie .

3. Governance & Quality

  • Data Governance: Enforce \"Good Governance\" practices, including rigorous Data Quality (DQ) checks and comprehensive documentation.

Qualifications

Technical Skills

  • AWS DMS: Experience handling output from AWS Database Migration Service or similar migration tools.


Soft Skills & Attributes

  • High Initiative: You are a self-starter who identifies gaps and fixes them without needing constant direction.
  • Execution-Focused: You prefer building and coding over pure theory/design.
  • Communication: Ability to document technical processes clearly for future maintenance.

  • Gestão de equipes, canais, políticas, reuniões e comunicação

title: Mainframe Storage Engineer (HOME OFFICE)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Mainframe Storage Engineer (IBM zOS systems) to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.


Job location: Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil .


All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).


We are seeking an experienced Mainframe System Engineer to join our team and provide operational, consultancy, and migration support in a complex IBM Z environment. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in mainframe operations, storage administration , and migration projects involving IBM and CA products. This role requires strong technical proficiency, problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams to ensure seamless system operations and migrations.


Job responsibilities :

  • Manage and support mainframe operations, ensuring high availability and performance.
  • Provide consultancy and technical assistance for migration projects
  • Implement and configure IBM storage solutions such as DFSMSrmm , DFSMShsm , and related advanced audit and reporting tools.
  • Assist with installation and configuration of IBM OMEGAMON for Storage and other monitoring tools.
  • Develop and maintain JCL scripts, REXX, and Assembler programs for automation and operational efficiency.
  • Utilize TSO and ISPF for system management and troubleshooting.
  • Collaborate with storage administrators to assess migration impacts and provide training/documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with system standards and best practices for SMP/E and z/OS environments.


Key skills :

  • Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in mainframe operations, service, or support roles.
  • Proficiency in TSO , ISPF , and JCL .
  • Ability to write REXX and Assembler programs.
  • Experience with DFSMSrmm and/or CA-1 Tape Management System .
  • Hands-on experience with IBM tools such as:

>> IBM OMEGAMON for Storage

>> IBM Advanced Audit and Reporting for DFSMShsm

>> IBM Advanced Catalog Management (ACM)

>> IBM Advanced Allocation Management (AAM)

  • Ability to migrate tools, including the following, within mainframe systems

>> CA-1 to DFSMSrmm migration (configuration, installation, JCL code, runtime parameters).

>> CA FAVER to IBM Advanced Catalog Management migration (customized JCL creation).

>> IBM Global Resource Serialization (GRS) migration (training, PARMLIB member creation,

operational considerations).

>> CA Allocate to IBM Advanced Allocation Management migration (installation, configuration, training).

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for documentation and stakeholder interaction.


Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Knowledge of IBM Z system operation and configuration, including SMP/E .
  • Familiarity with competing products and migration strategies.
  • Experience with Storage Administration on IBM Z .
  • Migration experience across IBM and CA products with ability to create customized JCL and runtime parameters.

title: Software Engineer Sênior - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas negras
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!

title: Engenheiro de dados
description:
O que você fará:

Projetar e desenvolver arquiteturas de dados que suportem indicadores estratégicos, metas e engajamento.

Construir e automatizar pipelines ETL/ELT integrando sistemas transacionais e analíticos.

Desenvolver e otimizar modelos de dados analíticos (Star Schema e Snowflake).

Escrever e otimizar SQL avançado (CTEs, funções de janela, ajuste de desempenho).

Implementar processamento e automação de dados usando Python.

Construir e manter plataformas de dados baseadas em nuvem na AWS

Trabalhar com Amazon S3, Redshift e/ou Athena para dar suporte ao armazenamento e análise de dados

Aplicar a qualidade, governança e linhagem dos dados em todos os conjuntos de dados

Colaborar com as partes interessadas do negócio para traduzir as necessidades do negócio em conjuntos de dados analíticos

Dar suporte a ferramentas de BI e análise, como Power BI, Tableau e Looker

Garantir a conformidade com os requisitos regulatórios e de governança em ambientes bancários e de fintech

Requisitos Mandatários:

Sólida experiência como engenheiro de dados.

Solida experiencia com SQL (CTEs, funções de janela, otimização de desempenho).

Experiência com modelagem analítica de dados.

Experiência prática na construção e automação de pipelines ETL/ELT.

Fortes habilidades em Python para processamento de dados e automação.

Sólida experiência com arquiteturas de dados em nuvem na AWS.

Experiência prática com Amazon S3 e Redshift e/ou Athena.

Experiência na integração de sistemas transacionais e analíticos.

Sólida experiência em armazenamento de dados e data lakes.

Experiência no uso do Git para controle de versão de código.

Sólido conhecimento de qualidade, governança e linhagem de dados.

Capacidade de traduzir requisitos de negócios em conjuntos de dados analíticos confiáveis.

Experiência com ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau, Looker).

Experiência anterior em ambientes regulamentados (bancos, fintechs, LGPD).

Diferenciais:

Experiência com dbt.

Uso de ferramentas de orquestração, como Airflow, Prefect ou Dagster.

Conhecimento de AWS Glue. Experiencia com IA.

Familiaridade com Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform).

Conhecimento de arquiteturas Lakehouse ou Data Mesh.

Experiência com plataformas de streaming de dados (Kafka, Kinesis).

title: Fullstack Java Engineer
description:
Who are we?

Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Europe - Romania, Poland, and Ukraine, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life.


Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 200 people over the past three years and plans to continue growing.


This role is for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer who can independently drive complex features from idea to production. You’ll work in a cross-functional Scrum team and be trusted to make sound technical decisions, even when requirements are incomplete.

This is not a ticket-driven role. It’s about ownership, judgment, and building software that holds up in production.


What you’ll own

  • End-to-end feature delivery: Drive features across frontend and backend — from technical discovery to release.
  • System design & quality: Design and evolve solutions for complex workflows and data flows, with a focus on reliability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Production mindset: Debug issues across environments, contribute to incident resolution, and build observability into systems from day one.
  • Engineering excellence: Uphold and evolve standards around code quality, reviews, and deployments. Mentor peers through thoughtful feedback.
  • Collaboration: Partner closely with Product, Design, Platform, and Support. Participate actively in Scrum ceremonies.

Must have:

  • Strong experience with a modern Java-based web stack
  • Hands-on experience with React.js and Typescript
  • Experience building and owning full-stack web applications
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms , preferably AWS
  • Strong communication skills and an ownership-driven mindset
  • Ability to work independently while staying aligned with the team

Nice to have

  • Kotlin and Dart
  • Experience with relational databases or data-heavy systems

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.


Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!


What is the role?

We are looking for a senior engineer with backend experience, who will join our team mainly focused on backend development, always focusing on delivering applications for high traffic access, well-monitored and fully tested. You will be responsible for the entire development lifecycle. In our team, everyone has the opportunity to share ideas, bring new solutions, and discuss them with other well-experienced engineers.


In this role you'll:

  • Write secure, efficient, and high-quality code that adheres to best practices, such as encryption of sensitive data and input validation.
  • Develop scalable and reusable code that promotes efficient development, such as creating reusable libraries and components.
  • Identify areas for improvement in the codebase and take ownership of small-to-medium-sized systems, such as fixing bugs and optimizing performance.
  • Quickly understand documentation and utilize testing techniques, such as unit testing, integration testing, and stress testing, to ensure high-quality code.
  • Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, such as providing regular status updates and actively seeking feedback.
  • Adapt to roadblocks and proactively resolve issues, such as debugging and troubleshooting.
  • Align work with customer value by using feedback to prioritize features.
  • Balance priorities and seek guidance when needed to make informed decisions.


What You’ll Bring:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building production web applications in an agile, startup environment.
  • Experience migrating domains from monolithic to microservices.
  • Experience working with systems at scale utilizing microservices, AWS services
  • Interest in learning or exposure to event-based architecture
  • Team player mentality: high collaborative, documentation-focused and recognizing how to balance asynchronous communications and virtual meetings
  • A passion for solving complex technical problems in both new and legacy codebases.
  • A mindset of leaving the codebase better than how you found it.
  • Experience collaborating with multiple team members with varying experience levels to design and implement technical projects.
  • Ability to work and problem-solve independently.
  • A humble, collaborative, customer-focused, and highly curious approach to problem-solving.


Nice to have:

  • Golang experience


This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.


Teachable encourages individuals from a broad diversity of backgrounds to apply for positions. We are an equal opportunity employer, meaning we're committed to a fair and consistent interview process. Please tell us in your application if you require an accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job.

We are looking for a senior engineer with backend experience, who will join our team mainly focused on backend development, always focusing on delivering applications for high traffic access, well-monitored and fully tested. You will be responsible for the entire development lifecycle. In our team, everyone has the opportunity to share ideas, bring new solutions, and discuss them with other well-experienced engineers.


In this role you'll:

  • Write secure, efficient, and high-quality code that adheres to best practices, such as encryption of sensitive data and input validation.
  • Develop scalable and reusable code that promotes efficient development, such as creating reusable libraries and components.
  • Identify areas for improvement in the codebase and take ownership of small-to-medium-sized systems, such as fixing bugs and optimizing performance.
  • Quickly understand documentation and utilize testing techniques, such as unit testing, integration testing, and stress testing, to ensure high-quality code.
  • Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, such as providing regular status updates and actively seeking feedback.
  • Adapt to roadblocks and proactively resolve issues, such as debugging and troubleshooting.
  • Align work with customer value by using feedback to prioritize features.
  • Balance priorities and seek guidance when needed to make informed decisions.


What You’ll Bring:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building production web applications in an agile, startup environment.
  • Experience migrating domains from monolithic to microservices.

  • Interest in learning or exposure to event-based architecture
  • Team player mentality: high collaborative, documentation-focused and recognizing how to balance asynchronous communications and virtual meetings
  • A passion for solving complex technical problems in both new and legacy codebases.

  • Experience collaborating with multiple team members with varying experience levels to design and implement technical projects.

title: Observability Engineer – PL/SR
description:
Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Observability Engineer – PL/SR para atuar no desenho, implementação e operação de soluções de observabilidade, garantindo visibilidade ponta a ponta dos ambientes, aplicações e serviços em arquiteturas híbridas e multicloud.

Irá atuar para um cliente sediado em Portugal


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar e manter pipelines de telemetria para logs, métricas e traces ;
  • Desenvolver e operar a infraestrutura responsável pela coleta, processamento e roteamento de dados de observabilidade;
  • Arquitetar, implementar e operar a plataforma de observabilidade baseada no Grafana Stack ;
  • Integrar soluções de observabilidade em ambientes híbridos e multicloud , suportando diferentes tipos de workloads;
  • Trabalhar com ambientes containerizados e orquestrados com Kubernetes ;
  • Integrar observabilidade aos pipelines de CI/CD e práticas GitOps ;
  • Atuar em conjunto com times de plataforma, SRE e desenvolvimento para evolução contínua das soluções.


Requisitos

  • Graduação em áreas de tecnologia;
  • Experiência com Kubernetes e ambientes containerizados;
  • Experiência com Grafana Stack (arquitetura, implementação e operação);
  • Conhecimento em pipelines de observabilidade (Logs, Metrics e Traces);
  • Experiência ou conhecimento em Azure ou GCP;
  • Familiaridade com CI/CD (GitHub Actions ou similares) e GitOps (Argo CD).
  • Disponibilidade para atuação remota o fuso horário de Portugal


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com OpenTelemetry;
  • Vivência em ambientes críticos e distribuídos;
  • Conhecimentos em SRE ou engenharia de confiabilidade.

title: Consultor(a) SAP Basis Projectos - Sênior
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Estamos procurando um(a) Consultor(a) SAP Basis Pleno/Sênior para atuar na administração de ambientes SAP complexos, tanto on-premise quanto em nuvem. Essa pessoa será responsável pela sustentação técnica, melhorias contínuas e participação ativa em projetos de atualização, migração e arquitetura SAP, com foco em Projetos.



Principais Responsabilidades


  • Projetar e revisar a arquitetura técnica SAP, abrangendo diferentes componentes e integrações;
  • Definir e implementar soluções técnicas alinhadas às necessidades de negócio e infraestrutura disponível;
  • Realizar instalações, atualizações e migrações de sistemas SAP, incluindo upgrades de EHPs, Support Packages e Kernel, em ambientes como: SAP ECC, S/4HANA, NetWeaver, Fiori e Solution Manager;
  • Gerenciar ambientes em diferentes plataformas (on-premise, cloud e híbridos), garantindo performance e segurança;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes funcionais, técnicas e de infraestrutura em projetos e suporte contínuo;
  • Apoiar na resolução de incidentes críticos, tuning e troubleshooting avançado;


Requisitos:


  • Experiência em RISE (S/4 HANA)
  • Sólido conhecimento em SAP NetWeaver (ABAP e Java) e SAP HANA;
  • Vivência em ambientes SAP S/4HANA;
  • Conhecimento em Solution Manager
  • Conhecimento em ambientes SAP Java (Portal, NWDI, NWDS);
  • Experiência comprovada com projetos de upgrade de sistemas SAP;
  • Experiência em projetos de conversão ECC para S/4HANA ou migrações para cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Inglês intermediário para leitura e comunicação técnica;
  • Graduação completa em áreas relacionadas à Tecnologia da Informação.


Diferenciais (Desejável):


  • Conhecimento em SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform);
  • Experiência com SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI) e SAP Integration Suite;
  • Conhecimento em SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC);
  • Vivência com banco de dados Oracle, DB2, SQL Server e HANA;
  • Certificações SAP BASIS, SAP HANA ou S/4HANA;
  • Inglês avançado
  • Espanhol avançado


Regime de Contratação: Modelo de CLT

Remoto


*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Five9 Developer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Five9 Developer who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Design, develop, and maintain communication solutions using Twilio APIs (SMS, Voice, Video, etc.), primarily using SMS.


• Integrate Twilio services with existing AbbVie applications like Salesforce and other pharmacy platforms.


• Create Twilio Flows to implement two -way SMS work flows for self service capabilities.


• Create messaging campaigns on Twilio communications platform.


• Work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, conduct technical analysis, and deliver robust solutions.


• Develop and maintain automated messaging systems, workflows, and notifications for internal and external users.


• Ensure solutions adhere to AbbVie’s security, compliance, and data privacy standards.

Buscamos um(a) Coordenador(a) de Capital Humano para atuar no Brasil, com responsabilidade sobre a coordenação das operações de RH em diferentes unidades operacionais e interface direta com a liderança.


Sobre a Função

A posição exige atuação próxima aos times locais, garantindo conformidade legal, execução eficiente dos processos de RH e alinhamento com as diretrizes corporativas.


Responsabilidades

  • Coordenar as operações de Capital Humano em múltiplas localidades no Brasil
  • Liderar e acompanhar um time de RH distribuído geograficamente

  • Supervisionar processos de folha, benefícios, relações trabalhistas e ciclo de vida do colaborador
  • Atuar como parceiro(a) de RH para lideranças locais
  • Gerenciar fornecedores e assessorias externas
  • Realizar visitas periódicas às unidades operacionais

  • Formação superior em Recursos Humanos, Administração ou áreas afins
  • Experiência prévia em coordenação de RH no Brasil
  • Conhecimento sólido da legislação trabalhista
  • Experiência em ambientes operacionais ou industriais (desejável)
  • Disponibilidade para viagens
  • Espanhol fluente


Modelo de Trabalho

Modelo híbrido, com presença presencial conforme necessidade das operações.

Esta é uma vaga confidencial. Informações adicionais serão compartilhadas ao longo do processo seletivo.

title: Pessoa Especialista de Dados e DevOps
description:
Sobre a vaga:

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO:

  • Projetar, implementar e gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD para entrega contínua de aplicações com qualidade e segurança.
  • Automatizar o provisionamento e configuração de ambientes utilizando Infraestrutura como Código (IaC).
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com desenvolvedores, SREs e engenheiros de plataforma para garantir confiabilidade e eficiência no ciclo de vida das aplicações.
  • Integrar validações de segurança e qualidade (DevSecOps) nos pipelines de entrega.
  • Apoiar times de desenvolvimento na adoção de práticas de GitOps, automação de deploys e rollback seguro.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de observabilidade, garantindo que logs, métricas e alertas estejam integrados ao fluxo de entrega.
  • Automatizar operações relacionadas a bancos de dados, como migrations, versionamento e sincronização entre ambientes.
  • Atuar em conjunto com o time de DBA para garantir que as mudanças em dados sejam seguras, rastreáveis e padronizadas.
  • Colaborar na evolução das plataformas de containers (ex: Kubernetes, OpenShift), otimizando deploys e escalabilidade.
  • Promover cultura DevOps entre os times, disseminando boas práticas de colaboração e automação.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:

  • Pipelines de CI/CD: GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Tekton, ou equivalentes.
  • Infraestrutura como Código: Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi.
  • Contêineres e Orquestração: Docker, Kubernetes (EKS, GKE, AKS).
  • Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK, Datadog.
  • Versionamento e Gestão de Código: Git, GitOps.
  • Automação de Banco de Dados: ferramentas como Liquibase, Flyway, Alembic.
  • Cloud Pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP.
  • Linguagens de automação: Python, Bash, Go (desejável).
  • Segurança em pipelines: integração de SAST, DAST, IaC scanning.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO:

  • Projetar, implementar e gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD para entrega contínua de aplicações com qualidade e segurança.
  • Automatizar o provisionamento e configuração de ambientes utilizando Infraestrutura como Código (IaC).
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com desenvolvedores, SREs e engenheiros de plataforma para garantir confiabilidade e eficiência no ciclo de vida das aplicações.
  • Integrar validações de segurança e qualidade (DevSecOps) nos pipelines de entrega.
  • Apoiar times de desenvolvimento na adoção de práticas de GitOps, automação de deploys e rollback seguro.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de observabilidade, garantindo que logs, métricas e alertas estejam integrados ao fluxo de entrega.
  • Automatizar operações relacionadas a bancos de dados, como migrations, versionamento e sincronização entre ambientes.
  • Atuar em conjunto com o time de DBA para garantir que as mudanças em dados sejam seguras, rastreáveis e padronizadas.
  • Colaborar na evolução das plataformas de containers (ex: Kubernetes, OpenShift), otimizando deploys e escalabilidade.
  • Promover cultura DevOps entre os times, disseminando boas práticas de colaboração e automação.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:

  • Pipelines de CI/CD: GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Tekton, ou equivalentes.
  • Infraestrutura como Código: Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi.
  • Contêineres e Orquestração: Docker, Kubernetes (EKS, GKE, AKS).
  • Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK, Datadog.
  • Versionamento e Gestão de Código: Git, GitOps.
  • Automação de Banco de Dados: ferramentas como Liquibase, Flyway, Alembic.
  • Cloud Pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP.
  • Linguagens de automação: Python, Bash, Go (desejável).
  • Segurança em pipelines: integração de SAST, DAST, IaC scanning.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Especialista de Operações (Operations Specialist)
description:
Responsibilities:

  • Execute and maintain operational workflows for cross-border payments (including fiat and stablecoin transactions) and VASP activities.
  • Monitor transaction costs, identify inefficiencies, and propose improvements to enhance operational performance.
  • Manage daily financial operations, including accounts payable/receivable, cash flow tracking, and crypto/stablecoin fund movements.
  • Maintain detailed records of all virtual asset activities to ensure compliance with internal
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal risk controls, including KYB/KYC/AML checks, reporting, and audit readiness.
  • Coordinate with banking partners, OTC desks, and internal teams to guarantee smooth settlement, reconciliation, and liquidity management.
  • Develop and implement scalable SOPs and operational tools to support business growth, ensuring reliability and consistency across markets.


Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience in operations, financial operations, or crypto-related back-office roles, preferably in fintech or Web3 environments.
  • Solid understanding of stablecoins, blockchain-based payment flows, and operational risk.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks with attention to detail.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English; proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus.


What we offer:

  • Competitive salary and benefits.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • A collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • The chance to work on cutting-edge blockchain technology and make a significant impact in the industry.


Preferred Qualifications: proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus

Job type: Full Time


Responsabilidades:

  • Executar e manter fluxos de trabalho operacionais para pagamentos transfronteiriços (cross-border), incluindo transações em moeda fiduciária (fiat) e stablecoins, bem como atividades de VASP.
  • Monitorar custos de transação, identificar ineficiências e propor melhorias para aprimorar o desempenho operacional.
  • Gerenciar as operações financeiras diárias, incluindo contas a pagar/receber, rastreamento de fluxo de caixa e movimentações de fundos em cripto/stablecoins.
  • Manter registros detalhados de todas as atividades de ativos virtuais para garantir a conformidade com as políticas internas.
  • Assegurar a conformidade com requisitos regulatórios e controles de risco internos, incluindo verificações de KYB/KYC/AML, relatórios e preparação para auditorias.
  • Coordenar com parceiros bancários, mesas de OTC e equipes internas para garantir liquidação, reconciliação e gestão de liquidez tranquilas.
  • Desenvolver e implementar SOPs (Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão) escaláveis e ferramentas operacionais para apoiar o crescimento do negócio, garantindo confiabilidade e consistência entre os mercados.

Requisitos:

  • Mais de 3 anos de experiência em operações, operações financeiras ou funções de back-office relacionadas a cripto, preferencialmente em ambientes de fintech ou Web3.
  • Sólida compreensão de stablecoins, fluxos de pagamento baseados em blockchain e risco operacional.
  • Fortes habilidades organizacionais e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas com atenção aos detalhes.
  • Fluência em Português e Inglês; proficiência em Espanhol e Mandarim é um diferencial.

O que oferecemos:

  • Salário e benefícios competitivos.
  • Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e inovador.
  • A chance de trabalhar com tecnologia blockchain de ponta e causar um impacto significativo na indústria.

Qualificações Preferenciais:

  • Proficiência em Espanhol e Mandarim é um diferencial.

Tipo de vaga: Tempo Integral

  • Termos Técnicos: Mantive termos como Stablecoin, VASP, OTC, SOPs e KYC/KYB/AML em inglês ou com a sigla original, pois são padrão na indústria de cripto no Brasil.
  • Adaptação Cultural: O tom é profissional, mas direto, típico de vagas de tecnologia no Brasil.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Data Enginee r who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Extensive experience (5+ years) working as a Data Engineer, with a strong focus on AWS technologies and serverless architectures;

- Experience working as a Data Engineer, with focus on Azure is valuable;

- In-depth knowledge of AWS services such as S3, Lambda, Glue, Athena, Redshift, and DynamoDB, and their capabilities for building scalable data processing systems;

- Proven expertise in designing and implementing AWS serverless architectures for large-scale data processing and storage;

- Strong programming skills in languages like Python, Java, or Scala, along with experience using SQL for data manipulation and querying;

- Hands-on experience with data integration and ETL tools, such as AWS Glue or Apache Spark, for transforming and processing data;

- English

Familiarity with data modeling techniques and data warehousing concepts, including star and snowflake schemas;

- Solid understanding of data security, access control, and compliance requirements in a data-driven environment;

- Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) and the ability to collaborate with analysts and data scientists to deliver actionable insights;

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a detail-oriented approach to ensure data accuracy and integrity;

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team environment

Key responsibilities:

Design and implement an AWS Serverless DataLake architecture to efficiently handle large volumes of data and support various data processing workflows;

- Develop data ingestion pipelines and data integration processes, ensuring the smooth and reliable transfer of data from various sources into the DataLake;

- Implement data transformation and data enrichment processes using AWS Lambda, Glue, or similar serverless technologies to ensure data quality and consistency;

- Collaborate with data scientists and analysts to understand their data requirements and design appropriate data models and schemas in the DataLake;

- Optimize data storage and retrieval mechanisms, leveraging AWS services such as S3, Athena, Redshift, or DynamoDB, to provide high-performance access to the data;

- Monitor and troubleshoot the DataLake infrastructure, identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks, data processing errors, and other issues;

- Continuously evaluate new AWS services and technologies to enhance the DataLake architecture, improve data processing efficiency, and drive innovation;

- Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior data engineers, fostering their growth and ensuring adherence to best practices;

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements, prioritize tasks, and deliver high-quality solutions within defined timelines

Data lake, aws, spark, python

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. Extensive experience (5+ years) working as a Data Engineer, with a strong focus on AWS technologies and serverless architectures;

- Experience working as a Data Engineer, with focus on Azure is valuable;

- In-depth knowledge of AWS services such as S3, Lambda, Glue, Athena, Redshift, and DynamoDB, and their capabilities for building scalable data processing systems;

- Proven expertise in designing and implementing AWS serverless architectures for large-scale data processing and storage;

- Strong programming skills in languages like Python, Java, or Scala, along with experience using SQL for data manipulation and querying;

- Hands-on experience with data integration and ETL tools, such as AWS Glue or Apache Spark, for transforming and processing data;

- English

Familiarity with data modeling techniques and data warehousing concepts, including star and snowflake schemas;

- Solid understanding of data security, access control, and compliance requirements in a data-driven environment;

- Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) and the ability to collaborate with analysts and data scientists to deliver actionable insights;

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a detail-oriented approach to ensure data accuracy and integrity;

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team environment

Key responsibilities:

Design and implement an AWS Serverless DataLake architecture to efficiently handle large volumes of data and support various data processing workflows;

- Develop data ingestion pipelines and data integration processes, ensuring the smooth and reliable transfer of data from various sources into the DataLake;

- Implement data transformation and data enrichment processes using AWS Lambda, Glue, or similar serverless technologies to ensure data quality and consistency;

- Collaborate with data scientists and analysts to understand their data requirements and design appropriate data models and schemas in the DataLake;

- Optimize data storage and retrieval mechanisms, leveraging AWS services such as S3, Athena, Redshift, or DynamoDB, to provide high-performance access to the data;

- Monitor and troubleshoot the DataLake infrastructure, identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks, data processing errors, and other issues;

- Continuously evaluate new AWS services and technologies to enhance the DataLake architecture, improve data processing efficiency, and drive innovation;

- Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior data engineers, fostering their growth and ensuring adherence to best practices;

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements, prioritize tasks, and deliver high-quality solutions within defined timelines
